$comment: Hinglish dialogue. Har key ek mission id + beat hai. 'speaker' characters.json ka id hai. Engine ye lines subtitle bar mein chalata hai.

generic:mall_violation.speaker: vicky
generic:mall_violation.text: Mall pe gaadi... ab to pakka pakde jaayenge.

generic:snow.speaker: vicky
generic:snow.text: Barf pad rahi hai. Sambhal ke chalana padega.

panga:l1.speaker: rahgeer
panga:l1.text: Aankhein ghar chhod ke aaya kya macho?

panga:l1.speaker: rahgeer
panga:l1.text: Oye bawa, side ho ja thoda.

panga:l1.speaker: dukandaar
panga:l1.text: Be, dhyan se! Saara saamaan gira dega.

panga:l1.speaker: rahgeer
panga:l1.text: Kya be, raasta tere baap ka hai?

panga:l2.speaker: rahgeer
panga:l2.text: Betiyachu, dobara laga to bendaga tod dunga teri!

panga:l2.speaker: rahgeer
panga:l2.text: Bawa, panga mat le. Seedha nikal ja.

panga:l2.speaker: dukandaar
panga:l2.text: Be macho, ab hilaya na to yahin patak dunga.

panga:l2.speaker: rahgeer
panga:l2.text: Ek aur baar laga na be, phir dekhna.

panga:l3.speaker: rahgeer
panga:l3.text: Bawa janta kaun hoon main, macho!

panga:l3.speaker: dukandaar
panga:l3.text: Aaja phir betiyachu, dekh lete hain aaj!

panga:l3.speaker: rahgeer
panga:l3.text: Be, ab tu gaya. Poora bazaar bulaunga.

panga:car.speaker: rahgeer
panga:car.text: Gaadi chalani nahi aati kya be!

panga:car.speaker: dukandaar
panga:car.text: Bawa, licence hai bhi ya aise hi ghuma raha hai?

m01_pehla_din:start.speaker: deepika
m01_pehla_din:start.text: Aa gaya finally. Gate pe khade rehne se attendance nahi lagti.

m01_pehla_din:start.speaker: vicky
m01_pehla_din:start.text: Bheed thi. Photocopy wale ke saamne teesre saal wale khade the.

m01_pehla_din:start.speaker: deepika
m01_pehla_din:start.text: Roz khade rehte hain. Dekhna mat, bas chal.

m01_pehla_din:end.speaker: vicky
m01_pehla_din:end.text: Vicky. Sanjauli se hi hoon sir.

m01_pehla_din:end.speaker: professor
m01_pehla_din:end.text: Sab Sanjauli se hi hain. Dekhte hain tu kitne din rukta hai.

m02_union_parcha:start.speaker: deepika
m02_union_parcha:start.text: Parche laga de campus bhar mein. Sameer ke ladke phaad rahe hain.

m02_union_parcha:start.speaker: deepika
m02_union_parcha:start.text: To phaad denge. Tu bas lagata ja.

m02_union_parcha:end.speaker: sameer
m02_union_parcha:end.text: Naya hai na tu? Naam yaad rakhunga.

m03_court_ka_faisla:start.speaker: professor
m03_court_ka_faisla:start.text: Court par vote hoga. Do sau ladke honge.

m03_court_ka_faisla:start.speaker: professor
m03_court_ka_faisla:start.text: Bhaagna mat. Jo bhaagta hai, usse yahan koi yaad nahi rakhta.

m04_bazaar_ka_hafta:start.speaker: dukandaar
m04_bazaar_ka_hafta:start.text: Beta, tu ab union ka aadmi hai na?

m04_bazaar_ka_hafta:start.speaker: dukandaar
m04_bazaar_ka_hafta:start.text: Har hafte koi aata hai paise lene. Bas ek baar keh de ki nahi dena.

m04_bazaar_ka_hafta:end.speaker: dukandaar
m04_bazaar_ka_hafta:end.text: Aaj koi nahi aaya. Pehli baar.

m05_baudi_ki_chudail:start.speaker: chhotu
m05_baudi_ki_chudail:start.text: Shart lagi thi. Aadhi raat, purani baudi, akele.

m05_baudi_ki_chudail:start.speaker: chhotu
m05_baudi_ki_chudail:start.text: Ek ghanta. Aur bhaag mat jaana, mujhe pata chal jaayega.

m05_baudi_ki_chudail:end.speaker: chudail
m05_baudi_ki_chudail:end.text: Itni raat ko paani bharne aaya hai?

m05_baudi_ki_chudail:end.speaker: chudail
m05_baudi_ki_chudail:end.text: Ja. Aur is baudi ka naam kisi ko mat batana.

m05_baudi_ki_chudail:end.speaker: chhotu
m05_baudi_ki_chudail:end.text: Bhai tu safed pad gaya hai. Kya hua wahan?

m06_igmc_ki_raat:start.speaker: deepika
m06_igmc_ki_raat:start.text: Chhotu ko maara hai unhone. Bazaar ke peeche.

m06_igmc_ki_raat:start.speaker: deepika
m06_igmc_ki_raat:start.text: Gaadi nikaal. IGMC, abhi. Ambulance ka intezaar mat kar.

m06_igmc_ki_raat:end.speaker: vicky
m06_igmc_ki_raat:end.text: Jisne maara hai, usko main jaanta hoon.

m06_igmc_ki_raat:end.speaker: deepika
m06_igmc_ki_raat:end.text: Vicky. Yahin ruk ja. Aage kuch nahi hai.

m07_navbahar_naka:start.speaker: sameer
m07_navbahar_naka:start.text: Ab tu bhi usi taraf hai jidhar main hoon.

m07_navbahar_naka:start.speaker: sameer
m07_navbahar_naka:start.text: Naka laga hai Navbahar pe. Nikal ke dikha.

m07_navbahar_naka:end.speaker: sameer
m07_navbahar_naka:end.text: College mein tujhse ladta tha. Ab tere saath hoon.

m07_navbahar_naka:end.speaker: sameer
m07_navbahar_naka:end.text: Farak ye ki ab upar wale hamare naam jaante hain.

m08_jakhoo_ka_sauda:start.speaker: netaji
m08_jakhoo_ka_sauda:start.text: Upar aa jao. Jakhoo pe baat hoti hai.

m08_jakhoo_ka_sauda:start.speaker: netaji
m08_jakhoo_ka_sauda:start.text: Mall pe sirf tasveer khinchti hai.

m08_jakhoo_ka_sauda:end.speaker: netaji
m08_jakhoo_ka_sauda:end.text: Har das saal mein main ek ladka dhoondta hoon. Is baar tum ho.

m09_mall_ka_julus:start.speaker: netaji
m09_mall_ka_julus:start.text: Bheed teri honi chahiye, naam mera. Abhi ke liye.

m10_vidhan_sabha:start.speaker: netaji
m10_vidhan_sabha:start.text: Aaj tay hoga ki uspe kaun baithega.

m10_vidhan_sabha:end.speaker: vicky
m10_vidhan_sabha:end.text: College ke gate se yahan tak paanch saal lage.

m10_vidhan_sabha:end.speaker: deepika
m10_vidhan_sabha:end.text: Aur us ladke ko yaad hai jo us gate se andar gaya tha?
